units.name: Soldier
units.description: Soldiers are all-round solid fighters, and they can capture or repair villages to give you benefits.

units.name: Archer
units.description: With their powerful bows archers can attack from a distance and are especially efficient against airborne enemies.

units.name: Aqua Elemental
units.description: Water elementals are friends of the water. When in water, they become much more stronger.

units.name: Sorceress
units.description: They are skilled in the use of necromancy. Sorceresses are weak in melee combat but they can summon skeletons from the dead to aid you in the battle.

units.name: Spirit
units.description: These mystical beings of pure light have an aura that can remove negative effects from your allies and heal them a little bit.

units.name: Wolf
units.description: Wolves are fearsome hunters with very high motility. They travel very fast on land and kill enemies with their poisonous bites.

units.name: Golem
units.description: Golems are ancient beings, incredibly strong in physical defence and are even stronger when in the mountains.

units.name: Catapult
units.description: Catapults blaze a trail of destruction with their enormous attack range. However they have very low motility.

units.name: Dragon
units.description: These massive flying beasts have ruled the sky since ancient times. They have very high motility and deadly melee attacks.

units.name: Commander
units.description: Commander is the heart of an army. He has quite strong battle skills and can capture enemy castles.

units.name: Skeleton
units.description: Skeletons are undead beings summoned by necromancers. They are not very strong but have poisonous attacks.

units.name: Paladin
units.description: Paladins are holy armies who are skilled at healing and can also capture villages like soldiers do.

units.name: Berserker
units.description: Berserkers are born fighters. The more enemies are around them the stronger they become.

units.name: Ghost
units.description: Ghosts are mystical undead beings. They float above the ground and can blind enemies with their attacks.

units.name: Black Mage
units.description: Black mages are skilled at using dark magic. Their attacks are always powerful against those with low magic defence.

units.name: Wolfarcher
units.description: Wolfarchers are high mobility version of archers. They can strike almost anywhere you want them to attack.

units.name: Ice Elemental
units.description: Ice elementals are mystical beings formed by pure ice. It seems they can fight well both in water and on land.

units.name: Slime
units.description: Mystic creatures. It seems their soft body can absorb a lot of damages.
